title: Eligibility and fees
summary: This document explains fee eligibility for the $6.00 monthly maintenance fee, including a waiver when your minimum daily balance is at least $500. It lists standard fees ($7.50 paper statement, $17.00 returned deposit, $12.50 incoming domestic wire, and a 25 stop payment) and how to avoid them (e-statements and maintaining $500+).
